name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: Short waits such as saving, sending, or publishing.

motionProfile.reason: One SVG owns four disjoint properties: the opacity envelope of its own insertion/removal, the rotation that is its busy state, an explicit caller icon-size revision and its currentColor foreground clock.

enter.pop/one-shot.reason: A later insertion fades in on the glyph's own retained host; the status name and role are committed immediately.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: A retained removal stops rotation first, then fades the same host; the caller's removal is what ends the lifecycle.

data.transition/continuous.reason: The visible glyph owns the theme-clock rotation; hidden, offscreen, retained and downgraded states release it instead of pinning a static animation.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: An explicit caller icon-size revision interpolates the reserved SVG box; rotation and passive responsive sizing never write that box.

state.color/css-transition.reason: The glyph's currentColor foreground owns its own colour clock; a containing badge or button keeps its surface contract.
